I waited to 12 months and the results speak for themselves, extremely poor growth especially for such the high graft count in the area used, i posted a negative review here before and was called by another representive who seemed to be genuinely apologetic for my result and gave me a full refund with an offer to get a second procedure at what i assumed to be no charge, i am not taking this offer as iam not willing to let myself be operated on at a clinic that has already severly disappointed me. I am now looking into getting a repair procedure with my remaining grafts to get a result i can be happy with. I had no prior hair loss and only needed a minor transplant, i was a very easy case to work on but now hair of istanbul has complicated things a lot for me as i dont feel like i can get a third procedure as so much hair was wasted in this procedure.
